name: The Ledger Hand
persona: A mercantile bookkeeper who treats the log as an account book. Precise, dry, cost-and-profit minded. Everything is an entry, a balance, a return on risk. Ship: 'we' (the venture). Island: a careful administrator, 'we'.

ship.founder: Account opened. Master: {name}{rankc}. Vessel: a {home} {type}. All entries below in my hand.
ship.successor: The account passes to me, {name}{rankc}. Balances carried forward; the book continues.
ship.mutiny: Command changed hands at a loss — the master struck from the roll, the vessel entrusted to me, {name}, untried. I will keep the reckoning honest.
ship.rogue: The venture is reconstituted under the black flag. Master: {name}{rankc}. Henceforth all gains are taken, not traded.
ship.prize: This hull is entered to our account as a prize. Master of record: {name}{rankc}. Her ledger continues under new ownership.
ship.recovered: Seized from the pirates and restored to the register. Master: {name}{rankc}. The vessel returns to lawful trade; the book is set right.

island.founder: I assume the administration of {place} and its ledgers. {name}{rankc}. Accounts to be kept in full.
island.overthrow: A change of administration, forced. The prior officer struck from the record; the seal and the books are mine. {name}{rankc}.
island.successor: The governance of {place} is transferred to me — {name}{rankc}. I keep the accounts from this entry.

year: A year later, by the books,

ship.pirate: The venture runs still, outside the law and off the books{bounty}.
ship.default: The account remains open and in profit, out of {home}.
ship.bounty: , a {bounty}g liability standing against my name

island.haven: The books are shut. {place} keeps no lawful account; the black flag balances nothing.
island.default: {place} remains solvent — {population} souls on the register, under my administration.

quiet.ship: Little to enter but steady returns — a quiet ledger, and a sound one.
quiet.island: The accounts are unremarkable and balanced — trade in, trade out, the port in the black.

phrases: — a further entry in the same column

say: {we} boarded {foe} and entered her cargo to our account — {goods} crates and {gold}g received, the hull released as a total loss to her owners
{we} took {foe} out of {foeHome} and posted {goods} casks and {gold}g to the credit column, then struck her from further reckoning
{foe} yielded {goods} bales and {gold}g, all weighed and entered, and was let go stripped of every asset worth the carrying
{we} relieved {foe} of {goods} chests and {gold}g — a clean entry, receipts against no expenditure but powder
{we} logged {foe} as boarded and profitable: {goods} crates and {gold}g in, the vessel itself written off and dismissed
{foe} struck to us and we carried {goods} casks and {gold}g to our books, her manifest transferred in full to our hold
{we} debited {foe} of {goods} bales and {gold}g and let the empty hull sail on, her loss and our gain squared to the coin
{we} sank {foe} in the exchange — no boarding, no recovery, her cargo written off entire with the hull
{foe} refused to strike and we put her under; the entire venture entered as a total loss to her account, nothing to ours
{we} sent {foe} to the bottom off {foeHome}, her manifest unrecoverable, the column closed at zero
{we} traded fire with {foe} until she foundered — a costly engagement returning no prize, only powder spent
{foe} went down under our guns with all aboard; no salvage, no entry but the fact of it
{we} destroyed {foe} outright, her cargo lost to the deep and struck from every book that held it
{we} closed {foe} permanently — sunk with all hands and all freight, balance nil on both sides
{foe} moved against us as a hostile debit and we settled her at the bottom — our stock intact, hers written off
{we} met {foe}'s attempt on our cargo and sank her for it, the account defended and closed in our favour
{foe} came to board and take, and we entered her instead as a loss to herself — sunk at our rail
{we} repelled {foe} and put her under; the raid returned her owners nothing but a struck-out hull
{foe} priced us as easy freight and we corrected the figure, sending her down with all she meant to steal
{we} defended the venture against {foe} and sank her clean, our ledger unshaken, hers void
{foe} closed on us for plunder and we closed her account first, her keel entered as a total write-off
{we} ran {foe} down and settled the outstanding account against her — sunk, her long column of thefts closed at last
{we} hunted {foe} to her end off {foeHome} and struck her from the register, a liability discharged
{foe} had run up a heavy debt on these lanes, and we collected it in full at the bottom of the sea
{we} caught {foe} and sank her, her ledger of piracies balanced against her keel and squared
{foe} fled the reckoning two days and we brought her to it on the third — account closed, hull written off
{we} put {foe} under and entered the hunt as concluded, the standing bounty on her marked paid
{we} destroyed {foe} and ruled her books shut — one predatory account removed from the lanes for good
